description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Radicle Health develops software products for human services organizations. The Junior Software Engineer will build and ship full-stack features and bug fixes, focusing on React interfaces supported by .NET Core APIs and SQL Server while learning the products and growing toward greater ownership.
Junior Software Engineer building full-stack features with React, .NET Core APIs, and SQL Server

Responsibilities:
• Build and ship well-defined features and bug fixes across the full stack, with a focus on responsive, accessible React user interfaces backed by .NET Core APIs and SQL Server
• Follow our best practices for code quality, testing, and the development process, including source control and deployment workflows, with support from colleagues on approach and design
• Take ownership of your work through launch and beyond, quickly noticing and addressing bugs, regressions, and open questions related to the code you shipped
• Collaborate actively with the team by giving and welcoming thoughtful feedback in pull request reviews, asking good questions in technical discussions, and asking for help early when you're blocked
• Protect sensitive data in line with Radicle Health's guidelines for PHI, using mocked or anonymized data in development and testing, including when using AI tools
• Build a strong understanding of our products, customers, and the Health and Human Services domain, and grow toward independently designing and delivering features with less direction

Requirements:
• 1–3 years of experience in software development, whether professional, internship, academic, or personal projects
• A BS degree, or equivalent professional experience or certifications
• Working knowledge of React, including hooks, component composition, and state and props
• Solid JavaScript skills and experience with HTML/CSS, including building responsive and accessible UI
• Some experience with C# and with state management tools such as Redux or React Query
• A working understanding of full-stack development and how the layers of an application communicate
• A foundational understanding of data structures and algorithms
• A basic understanding of source code management (such as Git) and deployment tools
• A track record of contributing to the delivery of a feature or project, and the ability to clearly describe your role in it
• A sense of ownership and accountability for the quality of your work
• A collaborative approach to working with other engineers, product managers, and QA, including openness to feedback
• An understanding of the responsibility that comes with building healthcare software, and of the importance of protecting PHI and other sensitive customer information

Preferred:
• Experience with Fluent UI
• Experience with front-end testing, such as Jest or React Testing Library
• Experience with a relational database, such as SQL Server, Postgres, or similar
• Experience building or consuming REST APIs with .NET Core
• Experience with AI-assisted development tools, such as Claude Code or Copilot
